title.en: An Act Appropriating the Sum of One Hundred thousand Pesos to Defray the Expenses of the Philippine Participation in the International, Colonial and Overseas Exposition to Be Held in Paris During the Year Nineteen Hundred and thirty-One.

text.en:
A Commissioner and an Assistant Commissioner shall be appointed by the Governor-General,
by and with the consent of the Philippine Senate, who, subject to the supervision and control of the Secretary
of Commerce and Communications and the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources, shall manage and
direct the Philippine participation in the International, Colonial and Overseas Exposition to be held in Paris,
France, during the year nineteen hundred and thirty-one. The per diems and traveling expenses of the
Commissioner and the Assistant Commissioner shall be fixed by the Secretary of Commerce and
Communications and the Secretary of Agriculture and Natural Resources.

There is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the Insular Treasury not otherwise appropriated
the sum of one hundred thousand pesos or so much thereof as may be necessary which shall be spent by the
Commissioner for the collection and purchase of Philippine exhibits and their containers, the cartage,
insurance and freight of the same, the display and care of the exhibits including the construction of the
necessary building, and the payment of salaries and wages of the necessary personnel and laborers, and such
other miscellaneous expenses as may be incidental to the carrying out of the purposes of this Act: Provided,
however, That not more than twenty-five per cent of the total amount appropriated herein shall be expended
for salaries and wages, per diems and traveling expenses of the personnel herein provided for.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 7, 1930.
